title: Mount Everest
text: Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas. Its elevation was revised to 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet) in 2020 following a joint Chinese-Nepalese survey. Everest straddles the border between Nepal and Tibet. Sir Edmund Hillary of New Zealand and Tenzing Norgay, a Sherpa from Nepal, made the first confirmed ascent on May 29, 1953. The mountain is known for its extreme conditions, including temperatures dropping below -60°C, wind speeds exceeding 200 km/h, and an extreme altitude that means the summit has only about one-third the atmospheric pressure of sea level.
